Name: (CP) Magical Fishing Raft
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][color=#ff0000][size=6]Notes![/size][/color]
[size=4]If you install this mod with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14594]SF version[/url]﻿ of the old mod, unexpected problems may occur, so please be sure to delete the [color=#f4f4f4]SF version﻿[/color] files when installing this mod![/size][/quote][color=#00ffff]

[size=5][center]Willy seems to have something interesting in mind.[/center][/size][/color]
[size=3]It is not a particularly terrific advantage, but it does add a little fun to the gameplay.[/size]
[color=#ffff00][size=5]Enjoy fishing in a nice location![/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]For return warp coordinate acquisition, it is easier and better to use "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url]".[/size][/color]

With the update of version 1.3, it is now possible to change the appearance of the raft to a boat instead of a raft.

[color=#00ff00][size=5]open conditions
[/size][/color][spoiler]
Wizard's friendship level is 3 or higher.
Robin's friendship level is 3 or higher.
Willy's friendship level is 3 or higher.

If you meet all of the above requirements, you will receive an email. Once you open it, you will be able to build.
[/spoiler]
[size=5][color=#00ff00]Conditions for opening the Desert and Island warps[/color]
[/size][spoiler]
Once the bass are repaired, a warp to a desert fishing point will be opened.
Once Willy's boat is repaired, the warp to the Island's fishing point will be opened.
[/spoiler]

[color=#ff00ff][size=4]Specification not a bug.[/size][/color]
It is a specification that no objects can be placed inside the hut or on the raft.
This is to make it appear that all rafts are identical.
It is a specification that the season is reflected in the appearance of the rafts in the desert and on the islands.
This is also to create the reality that the raft on the farm came from a warp.


Corresponds to "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]"

English and Japanese are supported.
